newsitem.title: POLAND: FARM FOOD RIGHTS FIRST LEG 94 PCT TAKEN.
newsitem.headline: FARM FOOD RIGHTS FIRST LEG 94 PCT TAKEN.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 562,722 shares in the first subscription period of the 600,000-share rights issue of Polish meat processing firm Farm Food SA, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
Farm Food has said a second period would take place from February 13 to 27 if the first phase was not fully subscribed.
The rights issue is priced at 33 zlotys per share. The stock closed on the bourse's main market on Tuesday at 46.2 zlotys.
